components.name: ButtonComponent
components.description:
ButtonComponent — base button for The Tractor Store Design System.

Supports multiple variants and sizes via CSS Custom Properties. Used across all MFEs (Explore, Decide, Checkout).

Example :
<ts-button variant="primary" size="md" (clicked)="onSubmit()">
  Ver catálogo
</ts-button>

components.description:
CardComponent — product card for catalog grids.

Displays product image, name, price and stock status. Navigates to product detail on click via routerLink.

Example :
<ts-card
  [productId]="product.id"
  [name]="product.name"
  [price]="product.basePrice"
  [imageUrl]="product.imageUrl"
  [inStock]="true" />

InputComponent — text input with label and error state.

Implements ControlValueAccessor for seamless Angular Forms integration. Used in search bars and checkout forms.

Example :
<ts-input
  label="Buscar tractores"
  placeholder="ej. TractorPro X200"
  [formControl]="searchControl" />

components.description:
PaginationComponent - page navigation for paginated lists. Emits pageChange when user selects a different page.

Example :
<ts-pagination
  [currentPage]="0"
  [totalPages]="5"
  [totalElements]="53"
  [pageSize]="12"
  (pageChange)="onPageChange($event)" />

components.name: PriceComponent
components.description:
PriceComponent — formats monetary values in Colombian Pesos (COP).

Handles large tractor prices (millions) with proper formatting. Uses Intl.NumberFormat for locale-aware currency display.

Example :
<ts-price [amount]="45000000" />
<!-- Displays: $45.000.000 -->
